title: A Phase III, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of CRD-7 in Patients with Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
indication: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
headline: CRD-7 shows significantly elevated SAE rate (39.8% vs 14.1% placebo) with hypotension signal; 29% of subjects quarantined for data quality issues.

title: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind Study of DRM-9 Versus Placebo in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
headline: DERM-404 at 53% enrollment shows higher SAE rate in investigational arm (35.5% vs 18.2%) with significant data quarantine affecting 24 subjects.

title: A Phase II, Randomized, Open-Label Study of SMX-401 Versus Docetaxel in Previously Treated Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
headline: SMX-401 shows higher toxicity than Docetaxel with 100% AE rate, 30.4% SAE rate, and notable hepatobiliary signals.

title: A Phase II Study of Inhaled RSP-12 in Adults with Moderate-to-Severe Asthma
headline: RESP-303 at 53% enrollment shows higher SAE rate in RSP-12 arm (35.5% vs 18.2% placebo) with significant data quarantine.
